notes: sfit is the MEarth Project's own least-squares periodogram with simultaneous linear decorrelation: the code of Irwin et al. (2011, ApJ 727, 56) that Newton et al. (2016, 2018) fit their null and sinusoid models with. It is pinned to a commit because its author publishes no release.
It is a C extension built at install: a C compiler is needed.
